 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the non-background pattern into the zero patch, mirrored left-to-right."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in g:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)

    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != 0]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    pattern = [g[r][sc0:sc1 + 1][::-1] for r in range(sr0, sr1 + 1)]
    for dr, row in enumerate(pattern):
        for dc, value in enumerate(row):
            g[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = value
    return g
